xml.brief: The caches on a cache list

desc.p: Returns the codes of the caches on one of the user's lists. To get all lists with their caches in one request, use include_caches of services/lists/query.

req.name: list_id
req.p: The id of one of the user's lists, as returned by services/lists/query. Another user's list, or one that no longer exists (e.g. deleted on the website), gives HTTP 400.

ul.li: cache_codes - the codes of the caches on the list, sorted,
